summary: Cloopen Group Holding Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based cloud communications provider quoted on OTC Pink under RAASY, filed a 6-K disclosing that shareholders at an EGM held September 24, 2026 approved the previously announced merger with SpringX Holdings, HoldCo and Merger Sub, with roughly 99.98% of votes cast in favor. The merger, structured as a Cayman statutory merger under Part 16, will make Cloopen a wholly owned subsidiary of HoldCo. No price per share, premium or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt. Closing conditions, regulatory approvals and the Schedule 13E-3 process remain; watch for closing timing, any dissenters' appraisal claims and OTC quotation termination.
